    ie = TVPlayHomeIE()

    from __init__ import InfoExtractor

    # Check the class-level attributes set on the class
    assert hasattr(ie, '_VALID_URL')

    assert ie.suitable('https://tvplay.tv3.lt/aferistai-n-7/aferistai-10047125/')
